records.name: Alpha Phi Omega
records.summary: A Penn chapter of a national service fraternity. Members volunteer together and go to social events, and new members join through the fall rush.
records.what_you_do: Help with the chapter's service work, take part in social events with other members, and meet people during rush.

schedule.text: Fall rush events were listed for September 8, 10, and 11, 2026. Other meeting times are not published.

first_step.how: Come to a fall rush event, then fill in the chapter's interest form to get on its email list.
first_step.basis: The directory lists an application, and the way in runs through rush and the interest form.

records.notes: The club website shows only Fall 2024 rush with no dates, so the directory's Fall 2026 rush dates are the only dated evidence.

records.name: American Institute of Architecture Students (AIAS) Penn
records.summary: Penn's student chapter of a national association for students of architecture.
records.what_you_do: Get involved as a member of the chapter. The club asks people to contact it by email to join.

first_step.how: Email the chapter to ask how to join.
first_step.basis: The directory lists the club as accepting members and gives an email as the way in.

records.notes: No dated events and no club website. The only other link is Instagram, which is a lead source, so status is unknown.

records.name: Association of Black Aspiring Dentists
records.summary: A Penn student group focused on the path to dental school for Black students, with mentorship, guides for applicants, and a free online dental assistant academy.
records.what_you_do: Read the group's guides for future dentists, take part in its free online academy, and join its listserv.

first_step.how: Email the group, or use the form linked on its website, to ask how to join. The page does not describe the membership steps.
first_step.basis: The directory marks an application as required, and the page does not explain the steps.

records.notes: The directory code is association-of-black-women-in-dentistry, but the entry's name is Association of Black Aspiring Dentists, so it was matched by name. The website is working but has no dated events or posts; its footer date (12/01/2024) is an establishment date, not activity, so no last_sign_of_life. The directory says membership is open to students but does not say whether non-Penn students may join.

records.name: Catholic Newman Community at Penn
records.summary: The Catholic campus center for Penn students, with weekly Bible study, Newman dinners, and a path into the Catholic Church for students who want to join.
records.what_you_do: Come to weekly Bible study or a Newman dinner, join a small group, or ask the center about becoming Catholic.

schedule.text: Weekly Bible study and weekly Newman dinners. The website gives no days or times.

first_step.how: Start on the center's welcome page for newcomers, then come to a dinner, Bible study, or small group.
first_step.basis: The center has a welcome page for newcomers and says students can come to its events. The directory marks an application, which the website does not describe.

records.notes: The website has no dated items, so status is probably_active. The directory email is a named staff address and was left out. The site says it also serves Drexel and the neighborhood, but does not say whether non-Penn people may attend events, so audience stays students.

records.name: Chabad House at Penn
records.summary: A Jewish campus center at Penn that hosts Shabbat dinners, holiday events, and a weekly newsletter for students.
records.what_you_do: Come to Shabbat dinners and holiday programs, or sign up for the weekly student newsletter and event updates.

first_step.how: Sign up on the website for the weekly student newsletter, or text the club's bot to get event updates and RSVP.
first_step.basis: Events are open to students with a simple sign-up. The directory's application flag refers to the student board, not to general membership.

records.notes: The site shows a weekly Torah portion linked to 10/8/2026, and candle-lighting times with no year beside them. Holiday dates on the site have no year. faith is left null because the directory says students from any background are welcome, though the center is Jewish. The student board application is separate and not recorded.

records.name: Ethics Bowl at Penn
records.summary: A Penn student team that talks through real moral problems together and prepares for ethics bowl competitions.
records.what_you_do: Discuss hard moral questions as a team and prepare for competition, including the national event.

first_step.how: Fill in the club's online application. The listed deadline was a Friday in early September, with no year shown.
first_step.basis: An online application is required before joining.

records.notes: Active status rests on the directory note that the 2025-26 team qualified for the 2026 national competition. No month is shown, so last_sign_of_life is left out. No club website.

records.name: Hillel
records.summary: Penn's Jewish campus center, offering morning prayer services, Shabbat dinners, and programs open to Penn students of any background.
records.what_you_do: Join a prayer service, come to a Shabbat dinner, or take part in a student program. Sign up for the weekly newsletter to hear what is coming up.

schedule.text: Events are listed by date on the website. A weekly Shabbat dinner is mentioned with no day or time given.

first_step.how: Sign up for the weekly newsletter or RSVP for an event. You can also reach the team through the contact page.
first_step.basis: Events are open by RSVP and the club welcomes all Penn students. The directory also marks an application, which the website does not describe.

records.notes: The website lists three events all dated October 8, 2026. A Penn for Israel meeting and a comedy writing group are listed on the site and are recorded as leads, not as part of this record. The site's phone line was not recorded.

records.name: Penn Symphony Orchestra
records.summary: Penn's orchestra for musicians from across the university, mostly students who are not music majors. It rehearses weekly and plays concerts at Irvine Auditorium.
records.what_you_do: Audition at the start of a semester, rehearse about four hours a week, and perform in the fall concerts.

schedule.text: Rehearses about four hours a week. Auditions take place in the first week of each fall semester. Fall 2026 concerts are on October 23 and December 5, both at 8 pm in Irvine Auditorium.

first_step.how: Prepare for the audition in the first week of the fall semester. Returning members send video recordings of excerpts. Ask the club for details first.
first_step.basis: A semester audition is required before joining.

records.notes: community_band is the closest tag because there is no orchestra tag. The directory and the website both list a conductor's personal-looking email, so no email is recorded. The conductor's name is not recorded.

notes: All 20 batch clubs were checked on their pennclubs directory entry. 14 club websites were also fetched. Six clubs have no website of their own (AIAS, Ethics Bowl, Sudanese, QuakerBots, Shea, Wharton Outdoors). No bot checks, paywalls, 403s or rate limits were seen. No Instagram, Facebook or LinkedIn page was read. Outcome: 15 records carry summaries and are publishable (7 active, 3 probably_active, 5 unknown). 5 records are held back with status unknown and no summary, categories or interests: Nonprofit Connect, QuakerBots, Women in Physics, The Accountability Initiative, and 180 Degrees Consulting, because the directory marks them inactive or not accepting and their sites show no dated activity. No street addresses are recorded: batch addresses did not appear on any page I read, so the pipeline can add them after a check. The Accountability Initiative batch address looks residential. Personal names and emails are left out: the Symphony conductor, the Newman staff address, the Daily Pennsylvanian's Wharton staff address, and the batch contact_name fields. Application flags conflict with some sites (Newman, Hillel, Rangoli, and the Daily Pennsylvanian's accepting-members flag is off while its site links an interest form); newcomer ratings follow the site where it is explicit and the basis line says so. Closest-fit tags: community_band for the Penn Symphony Orchestra, swimming for Men's Water Polo, hiking for Wharton Outdoors Club (activity inferred from the name). Heritage ids: none for Sudanese; South Asian groups have no single heritage id, so community is empty for Rangoli.
